mixes.name: Late Night Purrs
mixes.description: Dreamy favorites with a little listening history behind them.
mixes.rule: genre ~ "Dream" and favorite = true and rating >= 4 and play_count >= 3

mixes.name: Long Unplayed Tracks
mixes.description: Longer tracks that have never been played in MeowPlayer.

mixes.name: Not Unknown Artists
mixes.description: Tagged tracks that are not assigned to Unknown Artist.
mixes.rule: tagged = true and not artist = "Unknown Artist"
